title: Classic game totals and historical finishing ranks
label: RESEARCH_ONLY / OBSERVATIONAL / NOT PRODUCTION VALIDATED
verification: Independently reproduced from hash-verified archived inputs
success_definition: Top 10% means recorded rank <= ceil(full stored field size × 0.10), including all cutoff ties. Offensive selections count eight slots per classified legal roster; FLEX uses its actual position, DST is separate. Field includes top finishers.
findings: Top-10% lineups averaged 3.67 offensive players from high-total games; field 3.20.
Average selected offensive game total: 46.53 versus 46.15; difference 0.38.
50+ total games had mixed outcomes: offensive selection share was lower than field in Weeks 1 and 3, higher in Week 2.
Mean offensive team implied points: 23.72 versus 23.79 field.
DST opponent implied points: 20.19 versus 20.44 field.
controlled_comparisons: Exploratory lineup-level comparisons use contest intercepts, salary, prelock mean/P90 sums, position mix, QB/pass-catcher stacks, bring-backs and distinct games. No entry-level significance claims or production parameter fitting.
Average offensive game O/U: adjusted association +1.43 percentage points per one total point pooled, +1.70 with equal slate weights; individual-slate range -0.06 to +4.04. Descriptive only.

Average offensive team implied points: adjusted association -0.97 percentage points per one implied point pooled, +0.53 with equal slate weights; individual-slate range -2.13 to +3.17. Descriptive only.
DST opponent implied points: adjusted association -0.40 percentage points per one implied point pooled, +0.15 with equal slate weights; individual-slate range -0.49 to +0.71. Descriptive only.
High-total RB count: adjusted association +2.57 percentage points per one additional RB pooled, +0.98 with equal slate weights; individual-slate range -4.09 to +4.43. Descriptive only.
The high-total RB association shrinks after projection/salary controls and changes sign across slates; independent predictive value is unestablished.
Projected ownership was excluded: Week 1 has no recoverable prelock runs; Weeks 2–3 runs lack verified input provenance. Realized ownership is not a substitute.
Rank archives support 46,661 top-5% entries and 9,380 top-1% entries, including ties. No archived payout records support an actual-cash comparison.
limitations: Only three independent slates; overlapping contests and shared player outcomes remain dependent.
Means/P90 recovered from archived before-lock run/row clocks; recovered means exactly match hashed original export. These are archived model references, not calibrated player-quality controls.
No verified ownership control; cannot establish an independent effect beyond ownership.
Market captures were prelock but sometimes days/weeks old, not certified closing lines.
Complete-case projection controls exclude some entries; convenience sample and unknown contest structures limit generalization.
Roster deduplication occurs within contests; equal-slate and leave-one-slate-out diagnostics handle shared slates descriptively. No independent-entry confidence interval or cash claim.
Top-decile finishes are not paid positions. Historical percentages are not requirements or selection bonuses.
